say:7:1610738007:1.text: Gervan, Durella, Zorya. All three are suspects.
say:7:1610738007:1.source_cn: 格墨文、杜瑞拉和佐尔娅三个人都有嫌疑。

say:8:1610738008:1.text: But Gervan was with him when he was still alive!
say:8:1610738008:1.source_cn: 可是……可是格墨文和校长对话的时候，校长还活着啊！

say:9:1610738009:1.text: We don't have all the facts. I won't jump to conclusions.
say:9:1610738009:1.source_cn: 现在事情并不清晰，我不会随意下结论。

say:10:1610738010:1.text: You should go, Silven. And you are not to speak a word of what you've seen here to anyone. Is that clear?
say:10:1610738010:1.source_cn: 休，你先离开吧。未经我允许，刚才你看到的一切不可告知任...

say:11:1610738011:1.text: I understand. Thank you for allowing me to assist.
say:11:1610738011:1.source_cn: ……我知道了，伊芙特使。感谢你允许我参与调查，我先告辞了。

say:13:1610738012:1.text: Based on the evidence, I'll be questioning all three of them again.
